fragments.text: What if instead of "rulings" we follow your suggestions as a "default setting" and sort out the tuning and improvements later?

reply_text:
㊣ ("follow your suggestions as a 'default setting'") Yes, and done: all ten recommendations are now in force as defaults, each `→ Ruling:` line in `E-aif-cascade` filled with the setting and your sentence quoted at the head of the section (futon2 `4d2b8c1b7`). Any one can be revisited by name later; nothing is waiting on you now.

㊢ (what the defaults released, and what moved at once) R3 was mine to apply: `MeetWitness` in `ConstructionReceipt.lean` now runs its paths from the meet to the operands — the meet is the nearest common origin, `CascadeOrder`'s reading — and the diamond is re-proved with `observe` as the meet of `fill` and `injury`; all nine theorems in the module hold, `lake build` 584 jobs, no `sorry` (mathlib4 `7f497d3bd1`). R1, R2, R4 go into the R-cascade as data: the eleven-edge cut, R6 split and R4 not split (its `A`, `B` are the click's initial have), and a root unit `click-input`. That is A3, dispatched to codex-33: a third pass of `r-cascade.bb` under the defaults, meets emitted in the new direction, and a generated `RCascadeReceipt.lean` with `valid = true` plus the bad case of one absent-class edge with an empty token set, built with lake. Job `invoke-1791261716940-33331-c3306c8d`, running; park `park-ef5cc588`, deadline 55 min.

㊭ (order after A3) B4 part 2 under R5/R6 — rank the 103 cones with the item sheet, attention and the provisional prior as the only candidate-conditioned inputs, compare with the live selector's ranking of run c9d25d6a, each signal removable by a flag; then A4 (the Hasse drawing from the ruled edn) and A5; R8's measurement packet (per-step C with consumption, run on the §5 and B4 arrangements); R7 waits on B4 part 2 by its own default. R9 and R10 are text edits to CASCADE-SPEC-v3, mine, and I will make them when A3's review is done rather than interleave them now.

previous_reply_acts.text: (written) The ten items are in `futon2/holes/E-aif-cascade.md` as a new section, "Rulings — Joe's items", placed before DERIVE (futon2 `fa6a4a766`). Each has what is being decided, what the record shows with the report it comes from, the options, my recommendation, and a `→ Ruling:` line for you to fill with a word. previous_reply_acts.author: claude-2
previous_reply_acts.text:
(the ten, one line each, recommendation in brackets)
R1 the eleven-edge cut of the harness figure [accept as tabled].
R2 the R6 and R4 splits [split R6; treat R4-model as the click's initial have, not a unit].
R3 meet direction, where my two Lean modules disagree [`CascadeOrder`'s: the meet is the common origin; amend `MeetWitness`, re-prove the diamond with `observe` as the meet].
R4 a root unit for the click's input state [add it, so the R-cascade has one root like the outer diamond].
R5 operator load as preference term or support change [preference term].
R6 library coupling recorded or scored [recorded only].
R7 promote `meta/select-the-meta-item` [after B4 part 2 shows one run where its THEN held].
R8 inert tokens as no credit or a cost [no credit now].
R9 where the quality order enters G, c17 vs c10 [c10 for the order, c17's count in ambiguity].
R10 whether Goguen's house/boat order is the order for library patterns [defer, with §2a's reading as the working answer].

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-2
previous_reply_acts.text: (R9 and R10) I reconstructed the "two v3 decisions" from the draft's §4 and §7 since the earlier report naming them is not in front of me: the route of the quality order into G, and whether Goguen's three criteria are the right order for library patterns. If you had two different ones in mind, say which and I will swap them in.
